body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> WowWee announced its cutting edge product portfolio for 2008 which is being unveiled at the Consumer Electronics Show in Las Vegas.

From a WiFi enabled robotic webcam to an indoor flying machine with onboard navigation, WowWee continues to forge new categories in personal robotics and entertainment products that are both imaginative and inventive. Consumers can expect to see four distinct product divisions -- WowWee Robotics, WowWee FlyTech, WowWee Alive, and WowWee Fun– with something for every member of the family, including robot enthusiasts.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
